properties.description: As built (2026-09-17): a deferred_derivation TemporalFact on a part (record_finding fact_type deferred_derivation) is open until valid_to or INVALIDATES; while open, unmotivated_capability and unallocated_component skip that part, and loop_status lists it under deferrals with a next line — quieted on its subject, owed at the boundary, never gone. frontier (served) reports structure_without_intent (the detectors' own rules minus deferred subjects), deferred oldest first, uncaptured (coverage_report's unclaimed regions when a sweep is handed in; absent, not empty, without one) and resume_point (the most recent deferral). The adopt skill's Region mode: model the region, mark what you leave, ask with the region's scope, resume with frontier, settle by closing the marker. The scoped-detector defect this depended on was settled 2026-08-17 (default depth 2).
properties.name: Incremental, resumable adopt: a frontier read (structure without intent, deferred parts, uncaptured neighbours) and a deferred-derivation marker that is listed as owed and suppresses the intent gaps on its subject
